notes: P04 ACNS SoK claim extractor (RQ1, deterministic, NO LLM): evaluation/venue2027/acns/claim_extractor.py implements the task contract extract_claims(record) -> list[Claim] (the manifest's extract(paper)->list[Claim] with the orchestrator-directed name) plus the fail-closed gate assert_no_unsupported_claim(claims). Claim carries the five contract fields (claim_kind existence/boundary/performance per protocol section 6 C7, subject, evidence_boundary, asserted_guarantee, scope universal/existential/unscoped) plus traceability: text pointer (char span), verbatim quote (C1), evidence_class (six-class lattice), gap_codes (G1-G9 register restated from threat_model.md section 6), ambiguity flag (C8) and confidence. Each claim maps to the evidence-boundary taxonomy of sok_review_protocol.md section 8.2 / rater_manual.md section 3: BND_VALID (claimed level <= demonstrated ceiling), BND_OVERREAD with the specific gap (G1 transport-ack-as-processing, G2 receipt-as-execution, G3 execution-as-consumption, residual G7), BND_UNDERREAD (coverage insight), BND_INDETERMINATE (hedged/undecidable wording retained, never coerced, rater manual section 5 IND); evidence_boundary=None marks a guarantee with no disclosed evidence (G9 shape) for the fail-closed gate. Deterministic rules only: ordered sentence segmentation, caption (Figure N:) and ablation footnotes skipped (task negative vector), negated-proof sentences coded as boundary claims not positive ones (anchor C7-A2), performance sentences context-only, hedges -> INDETERMINATE/low-confidence, marketing-only records (>=2 promotional markers, no disclosed evidence artifact) yield no confident claim per the protocol's EXCL_NOT_PEER_REVIEWED channel; demonstrated level (C4) derives from the record-level D3 evidence inventory with the class-to-level ceiling and strongest-evidence priority (rater manual section 2 C2/C4). Fail-closed semantics with stable reason codes: MALFORMED_RECORD, EMPTY_TEXT, MALFORMED_CLAIM_LIST, MALFORMED_CLAIM, UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM_NO_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY (raised by assert_no_unsupported_claim when a claim asserts a guarantee with no evidence boundary - never a silent pass). No LLM, no network, no clock, no randomness, no PHI/PII (synthetic-acns-2027-style inline fixtures only). Test driver research/venue2027/acns/tests/test_claim_extractor.py (11 tests, positive + adversarial): P1 receipt-scope claim BND_VALID/L2 deterministic, P2 receipt-as-execution BND_OVERREAD+G2, P3 negated-proof boundary claim, P4 determinism (byte-identical to_dict), P5 schema vocabularies + JSON-serializable, A1 unsupported claim refused by the gate (stable code) while supported claims pass, A2 marketing-only record yields no confident claim, A3 captions/ablations not claims, A4 malformed input fails closed with stable codes, A5 hedged wording retained INDETERMINATE (never coerced), A6 underread coverage insight.
